preservation.existing_studio_preparation: Retain existing Studio spec/contracts and 5484 draft microtasks as carried-forward scope/provenance. Root supplied count, not implementation evidence.
preservation.native_workspace: One Studio workspace/shell and one shared StudioDocument across raster/vector/design/publication/RAW/timeline/motion workflows; no seven parallel application authority models.
preservation.ai_scope: Adobe AI reimplementation remains out of requested scope. Non-AI features are not discarded because reusable libraries lack them.

authority_reconciliation.issue: §14.2 currently says one standalone studio-engine crate owns all compute. Operator expressly rejects a single Studio crate and requests independently buildable modular assets.
authority_reconciliation.proposal: Replace single-crate wording with a many-crate DAG in the same repo: lightweight contracts/document, separate engines and heavy adapters, optional facade only for selected composition. Separate Studio workspace/package commands must not depend on core/native/Surreal; later owned binding crate may.
authority_reconciliation.scope_limit: Do not amend unrelated Studio scope or move governance into product checkout.

authority_reconciliation.issue: Early STU-OVR-015 excludes NLE; later STU-VID-001 explicitly supersedes it.
authority_reconciliation.proposal: Carry current footage timeline/motion/VFX scope and later chapters forward; no new timeline exclusion or duplicate director ownership.

authority_reconciliation.issue: MCP actual attribution field reported by UI audit is client_session_id; HBR-VIS says agent_label. Widget leases do not provide document-object mutation leases.
authority_reconciliation.proposal: Use a documented versioned envelope/adaptation with client/session attribution, object revision/lease/conflict receipts. Resolve wire naming in owning contract before implementation, never silently invent alias.

authority_reconciliation.issue: HBR canary/test_entrypoint/implementer_check contain REPLACE_ME placeholders; WP012 commands/owner IDs are scoped to its work.
authority_reconciliation.proposal: Studio activation defines one checked-in scoped runner/batch, canary and permitted implementer check, exact owned external targets and chosen feature/package closures before builds.

authority_reconciliation.issue: Media audit finds LightCraft Lightroom import uses custom SQLite page parser despite snapshot/log native catalog. Existing CX-503R and STU-OVR-003 forbid SQLite even import.
authority_reconciliation.proposal: Do not adopt that importer under current contract. Preserve Lightroom migration scope; ask owner to reconcile approved exception or choose non-SQLite interchange/export input. Do not claim it is solved.

current_architecture.finding: Repository already has multiple Rust packages, despite operator's broad single-crate description. Core remains very large and heavy; native GUI is also one broad crate.
current_architecture.implication: Define package and owner compilation boundaries; workspace membership alone does not isolate code.

current_architecture.finding: Static core/native source size highlights ownership breadth, not measured compiler causality.

measure.method: Read-only PowerShell .rs file enumeration and Measure-Object -Line (nonblank lines), includes inline tests and schemas.

current_architecture.proof_limit: No clean/warm timing, peak memory, critical path or relink measurement performed.

current_architecture.finding: EditorSurface retains a design-only source header, but InteractionBus has actual callback dispatch to an empty registry. No production surface registration was found in the complete WP012 root drill; PaneFactory owns actual mounting. See HS-DRILL-005 in handshake-root-drill.json.
current_architecture.implication: Standalone harness first; later bind via owned native surface implementation and runtime proof.

current_architecture.finding: Diagnostics already have useful independently packaged ring/survivor substrates; GUI diagnostics and core business-event/manual types are not independent leaf crates.
current_architecture.implication: Neutral ports and shared schema dependencies, then integration adapters, avoid pulling entire app into each engine.

current_architecture.finding: Current Rust 1.97.1 exceeds inspected upstream MSRV 1.95/1.90, but Handshake egui 0.33 and ArtCraft egui 0.36 have different types/APIs.
current_architecture.implication: Engine leaves can be adapted separately; importing upstream GUI is not an embedding shortcut or approved native GUI upgrade.

proposed_architecture.naming_authorization: Operator explicitly requests fitting Handshake-themed crate names. Names below are proposals, not canonical project names.

principles.proposal: One independently selectable Studio asset workspace with lightweight default members; every target imports only its declared dependency closure. No single Studio crate containing all engines.
One shared document schema/contracts and one kernel authority adapter. Engine algorithms receive immutable typed data and produce values/patch proposals.
GUI, GPU, native codecs, image/RAW/font/import dependencies stay out of foundation/document types. Heavy adapters remain separate packages or optional provider features.

A package facade/provider registry may compose selected engines, but no unconditional all-engine reexports/dependencies. Trait objects/typed ports keep consumers from importing provider implementations.
A crate boundary must have a real owner/API/dependency or compile-isolation reason; do not turn every slider/effect into a tiny crate or rebuild a panel per workflow.
Use one canonical reusable panel/control mechanic configured through typed properties/actions/units/preconditions; manual/Argus/accessibility derive from that registry.

nodes.responsibility: Stable IDs, units, revision and capability schemas, cancellation/result/loss contracts; no GUI/GPU/database/media dependencies.
Typed diagnostic sink/progress and correlation ports; do not copy authority/FlightRecorder into each engine.

One StudioDocument graph/schema and immutable snapshots shared by all domains, not per-vendor models. Photo virtual-copy/develop recipe links reference CKC asset identities; catalog keywords/collections/relink authority is CKC, never a Folio-private catalog.
Pure typed transactions, proposed patches, conflict/undo validation; kernel remains durable EventLedger/CRDT owner.
Profiles, rendering intents, linearization/ICC transforms; cached results keyed by profile and engine version.
CPU tiles, sample formats, masks, brush/raster operations; no GPU/device dependency.
Vector geometry/path operations, live geometry validation; no raster editor dependency.
Shared fonts, shaping, fallback, bidi/script and glyph runs used by all visual/temporal domains.
Publication/page/threaded-frame composition, overset/preflight, tables and multilingual paragraph algorithms.

RAW decode/develop recipes; originals immutable through CKC/ArtifactService provider identity, target-independent scalar oracle and SIMD dispatch. Imported catalog semantics adapt into existing CKC owner, not a private Studio catalog.
Components, variables, responsive constraints, prototype actions within same document; no separate Figma-like app.

Canonical integer-tick sequence time at 254016000000 ticks/second per STU-VID-012 and normalized broadcast ticks/frame per STU-VID-013. Preserve declared field types with checked arithmetic/range; rational time is for interchange adapters, never a competing stored authority. Own edit/trim/ripple/multicam references and scheduling; media decoder behind typed port.

Audio integer sample/channel/timing, DSP, spectral selection/repair/restoration, mix/routing/streaming/latency and waveform/loudness semantics for picture-post workflows. Device I/O such as CPAL, native codecs and plug-in hosting are separate optional provider leaves, not implied pure DSP support.
Decode/encode media/proxy-provider adapters; native codec bindings opt-in, never reachable from raster/type default closure.

Keyframes/easing, compositing/effect graph semantics and expressions policy; shared exact time/schema comes from Accord/Folio. Sequence/media references use provider contracts, so composition/keyframe math does not unconditionally pull NLE edit algorithms. No vendor runtime.

Static render-plan evaluator consumes immutable snapshot; same semantics for previews/export. Temporal/effect providers attach through typed ports; no unconditional motion/pulse engine dependency in the static render closure.
CPU render backend/reference; opt-in professional reference cases require external independent oracles.
wgpu backend/device lifecycle, residency and budgets; GPU API types hidden from document/contracts.

Native document container serialization, manifest/hash references, atomic recovery and bounded loading. Stream asset bytes through CKC/PRIM-ArtifactService provider ports; no private catalog, preview cache, metadata store, watcher or second CAS under STU-ASSET-004/009/010. Standalone fixtures supply scoped in-memory resolver inputs rather than kernel imports.
PSD/PSB conversion with provenance and structured unsupported/loss report; preserve originals/unknown bytes.
SVG/AI/PDF adapter family; split heavy PDF parser out of default SVG closure when graph evidence warrants.

Offline .fig proprietary-version decoder and conversion adapter owner; decoder availability NOT_PROVEN. Preserve original/source-qualified IDs and map components/variants/variables/modes/auto-layout/prototypes with loss receipts. SVG/PNG/token/API interchange does not replace required editable .fig import.
IDML/INDD/print interchange conversion; no claim INDD readable without actual decoder proof.
Native video/motion/catalog interchange; loss-aware typed graph adapters, licensed format support remains evidenced per fixture.
One shared egui control/panel mechanic configured by capability registry; agent projections/manual use same semantics; never imports full native app.

Headless single-document operation orchestration, provider registration and test ports. Multi-output delivery captures immutable revision/presets/output verification and uses existing Job Runtime via a port for queue/watchfolder/cancel/retry, without a second job database or queue authority. No built-in all-engine mega dependency.
Standalone Studio asset desktop/CLI harness; domain engines/renderer loaded through explicit feature/member selections.
Later owned adapter for AppState/EventLedger/SurrealDB/PromotionGate/Argus/manual. Only this integration target may depend on handshake_core/native integration surfaces.

standalone_to_embedded.stage_one: Implement approved pure contracts/document + one focused domain engine/harness proof in Studio product worktree; shared control/Argus/telemetry ports present from the first asset.
standalone_to_embedded.stage_two: Additional domains attach through providers in same document/workspace, not new windows/app silhouettes.
standalone_to_embedded.stage_three: An authorized integration packet binds stable ports to WP012 native surfaces, FR, internal diagnostics/Palmistry, UserManual, kernel store/proposal/promotion. Runtime embedding remains separate proof.
standalone_to_embedded.dependency_direction: Kernel adapter imports Studio contracts/providers; Studio leaves never import kernel/native.

controls.proposal: Pin Rust/toolchain/lockfile and explicit resolver/default-members. Checked-in runner invokes exact packages/features; avoid cargo --workspace as routine leaf edit check.

Before engine implementation, cargo metadata/tree closure must show standalone target has no core/native/Surreal/RocksDB, and contracts has no GUI/GPU/codecs. Record features and duplicate package versions.

Measure first cold and warm focused target timings/peak memory/artifact size/relinked binaries once at stable inputs. Set numeric budgets from measured environment and operator requirements, not unmeasured promised speedup.

Warm single-leaf edit proof records only leaf/dependents rebuilt; fixture compares actual compiled-crate/relink list to declared affected closure. Controls edit must not rebuild native codecs or core.

Use one stable governed owner source path refreshed changed-files-only/current mtimes, identity SHA/tree/file-count/manifest hashes, canonical external scoped artifact/cache paths, no cargo clean for candidate changes.

WP012 currently mandates one Cargo process for its scoped owner/proof workflow. New Studio activation must define compiler concurrency from measured CPU/memory/disk resources and canonical owner targets; this x64 Ryzen host has not been measured as constrained. Preserve Surface-specific caps when required. Batch compatible checks/shared prerequisites and schedule validators so compiler work does not compete unsafely for an owner target. Parallel swarm source ownership does not imply parallel Cargo processes.

Choose the measured developer feedback lane after inspecting current cache settings: Rust incremental compilation and sccache Rust caching are separate alternatives because incremental disables sccache cacheability. Do not blindly enable both. Avoid upstream release LTO/codegen-one defaults for feedback. Final release packaging has its own measured target/profile and exact runtime proof.

x64 Windows product proof must run exact target binaries with native dependencies and declared DX12/GPU backend. ARM64 Surface source/portable-unit checks are useful separate evidence, never x64 runtime PASS.
Each SIMD/codec/GPU backend has explicit target cfg and runtime capability dispatch plus scalar reference. Reject native x86 instructions or SDK assumptions in portable contracts/leaves.
GPU absence/device loss/fallback is explicit diagnostic and proof state. Required render test never silently skips; export and agent screenshots bind rendered revision/time/color/provider.
Cache-key artifact records include target triple, toolchain, lock/features/profile and candidate identity; cache hit itself does not prove correctness or compatibility.

build_and_platform_proposal.proof_gap: No benchmark, compile, cache result or target compatibility proof produced in this research session.

controls.proposal: Each command carries stable domain object IDs, observed document revision, actor/client/session identity, idempotency key and declared read/write set; result includes accepted/conflict/rejected receipt.
Parallel agents own independent view/selection/prototype preview state. Shared mutations are proposals against immutable revisions, not coupled active-pane keyboard focus.

Document transaction manager enforces object/tile/time-range leases and conflicts; global color/profile, dimensions, shared font/style/variable or timeline ripple changes require wider conflict/barrier semantics.

Brush/path/time gestures are typed batches with preview/commit/cancel; no new arbitrary canvas coordinate-only endpoint for each tool. Existing Argus methods route discoverable controls; semantic gestures require owner contract.
Preview/visual verification observes exact document revision, render generation, frame/time, input/working/display profile and proxy/original choice. Stale captures cannot certify mutations.

Undo is conflict-aware and attributable; one agent cannot silently undo another's later edit. Export captures immutable revision and referenced assets; cancellation/deadline reports partial work, never corrupt authority.
CRDT cooperation does not imply all bitmap/native media operations commute. Keep kernel CRDT/EventLedger owner and specialized proposal merge policies per primitive.

controls.proposal: Each new engine exposes one neutral diagnostic sink/progress port and configured no-op/buffer implementation for isolated tests; do not import core just to log.
Reuse handshake-diag-ring wire schema through sanctioned shared dependency/extraction path; do not clone ring layouts and invent private numeric codes.
Register Studio operations in owning watchdog/schema contract; render/media export progress uses meaningful work counters and absolute deadlines. Alive UI heartbeat cannot hide dead GPU/codec worker.
Record per-tier WIRED, NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason or DEFERRED-with-reason and integration follow-up. Standalone memory sink is not production FR/Palmistry proof.

One UserManual canonical surface accepts shared generated descriptors for tools/primitives/units/object selection/preview/commit/inspect/recovery and diagnostic evidence. Do not invent a second ModelManual.

Each public control/action/value range/schema is discoverable to humans, accessibility and models, including invalid states/unsupported conversions. Example command/results and visual verification receipts permit no-context operation.

STU-ARC-001–006 and STU-DOC-001–004 provide existing module, event, ID, sandbox/promotion, engine isolation and unified document contracts.

Native app already imports independent handshake-diag-ring by path.
